name: Ngong Hills ridge walk
why: Along the knuckles of the Ngong Hills, the ridge Karen Blixen saw from her farm, between Nairobi and the Rift Valley.
book: Kenya Forest Service ticket at the gate; a ranger escort is advised.
dangers: Walk with a ranger: robberies have happened.

points.name: Ngong Hills gate
points.note: The forest station above the town of Ngong.

points.name: Lamwia peak
points.note: The highest knuckle of the ridge, 2,460 m.
